title: Constraint-aware physical auto-placement
summary: Implemented full-layout and missing-placement automation for interconnect physical canvases.

dates.note: First inspected milestone: 2026-07-01. See facts for earlier/later feature stages; this is neither proof of first-ever work nor a formal role/leadership start or shipped release date.

facts.text: Created physical-canvas auto-placement for newer NoC tooling.
Implemented grid alignment, collision avoidance, interface/blockage grouping, logical ordering, die sizing and Configuration Engine persistence for full layout or missing placements.
Added placement regressions checking alignment, overlap avoidance, die containment, grouping and interface/bridge adjacency across SVG and Pixi modes.
Designed auto-placement as a deferred, project-bound operation with active-run and generation guards, reconciling live model state before allocating and persisting locations.
Implemented full and missing-only layout modes with grid/collision allocation, interface/bridge adjacency, blockage grouping and die sizing; missing-only reserves valid existing placements.
Missing-only placement does not promise to preserve invalid or overlapping locations; no elapsed-time or silicon PPA improvement has been established.

notes: No placement-time saving or silicon PPA improvement has been measured in the supplied sources.

2026-10-27 local Git/source research supplements prior evidence. Authorship supports attributable implementation; shared components and later colleague changes retain separate ownership. No employer tests were rerun.
